why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Esmerlyn Valdez is slot #2 (4.409 expected team runs/game).
Slots #2, #6, #7, #3, #1, #8, #5, #4, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #4 ranks 8 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.003 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.56 expected PA/game vs 4.34 at primary slot #4. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
